name: feet-elevated depth push-up
description: A feet-elevated depth push-up with the hands dropping from two raised supports to the floor between them, training explosive chest and arm power.
instructions: Place your feet on a sturdy bench and your hands on two stable raised supports with floor space between them.
Keep your body straight and lower into a push-up on the supports.
Press up explosively and move your hands off the supports, landing softly on the floor between them with bent elbows.
Press back up, reset your hands on the supports and repeat only while you can keep the landing controlled.
